performance.cold_tradeoff: Eligible L1/L2 miss adds two serial probe states before PTW. Startup numbers include boot and cold warmup, not isolated cold-only latency. Context-remap guest increases 12669->12755 cycles despite 99->96 walks; report that overhead separately.

mapping.scope: Standalone SvTranslationService including walker andPMP16; maxLevels3, writeReadReuse=true, loadPeek=true. Full dynamic demand+peek/PMP inputs retained; adapter, I-TLB and PTE cache excluded. Unsited LUT6-oriented Yosys mapping, no ns/STA/board incremental cost claim.

memory_accounting.basis: xcup synth_xilinx uses lutrams_xc5v_map.v SDP case ABITS=6 WIDTH=7: seven read-data LUTs A-G plus H write-address LUT site; RAM64M8 definition has eight 64-bit INIT banks. Count full eight-LUT primitive allocation, not only 196 live data lanes.

mapping.depth_scope_note: Existing structural extractor treats RAM primitives as sequential boundaries. Reported L1 demand/peek cones match D16; all-cone depth does not characterize asynchronous LUTRAM read internals, delay, fanout or placement.
